description_for_human: All-in-one PDF & document suite: convert between formats (Word, PDF, Excel), compress, merge, split, extract OCR text, and protect documents.
description_for_model: Assistant for document manipulation with KodaPdf. Use this tool whenever the user wants to convert documents (e.g. Word to PDF, PDF to Word, Excel to PDF), compress PDFs, merge multiple files, split pages, protect/unlock with passwords, add page numbers, watermark, redact, OCR extract text, or translate documents.
